text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"—Despite the rain hitting Nakayama Racecourse,
a massive crowd of fans has gathered.
We can even spot banners for Mr. C.B.!"

text_block_list.name: Commentator in a Suit
text_block_list.text:
"Mr. C.B. is definitely going to win today.
...I really hope she wins the Derby, too."

text_block_list.name: C.B. Fan A
text_block_list.text:
—C.B. will win! Of course she will!
That's just the kind of Umamusume she is!

text_block_list.name: C.B. Fan B
text_block_list.text:
"Hang in there, C.B....!
You can totally become a Triple Crown Umamusume...!!"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Red Ribbon
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, that's insane... With this many people here,
it's practically all CB-san fans...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Black-Rimmed Glasses
text_block_list.text:
Let's at least cheer for her ourselves.
You can do it, Ace-chan...!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Pheeew...――

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"...The Satsuki Sho really is something else.
The shift in atmosphere is electrifying, even all the way in this waiting room...!"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
But... I'm totally fine!
I'm just itching to run this Nakayama course as soon as possible!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems Katsuragi Ace is maintaining a good level of tension,
complete with that pre-battle shiver of excitement.
I can send her off without worry...!
choice_data_list: I'll show you how Katsuragi Ace runs!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Yeah!
Alright then, I'm off!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
(Her spirit feels like it's piercing right through my skin...!
So this is the pressure of the Umamusume competing in the Satsuki Sho...!)

text_block_list.name: Shiina Frejus
text_block_list.text: —She seems to be in top form.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Fréjus...!
Look at you, all fired up and in peak shape yourself...!

text_block_list.name: Shiina Frejus
text_block_list.text:
"I declared that I would defeat you, after all.
...Let's make this a good race."

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Yeah. I'm not gonna lose—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: (What the?! Suddenly, my body feels so heavy—)
—It's a pleasant rain, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
“Still, I'll probably end up covered in mud by the end.
...Well, that's totally fine too!”

text_block_list.name: Shiina Frejus
text_block_list.text: This is... to think it's to this extent...—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: (Are you kidding me...?! Calling this growth since the Kyodo News Hai doesn't even begin to describe it...!)

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
(She's on a completely different level now...!
It's like a massive mountain right before my eyes,
a presence so intense it makes you forget to breathe...!!)

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
(Wait, could this be—
the true form of C.B....?!)

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: (This is bad... My body's trembling...!)

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: —Well then, shall we begin?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Taking the first match of our best-of-three.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: (—I swore I'd answer their expectations...!)

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: (As their... "Ace"!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Let's race, C.B.!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"In this Satsuki Sho,
I am going to beat you!!!"

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: ...Now that's what I'm talking about.
